examples.en: Friend, have you seen my red cow? I have not seen her. When did she go away? She went away in the night. Then look for her tracks near the river.

examples.pie: ph₂ter moy sokʷéye kʷóm h₂élbʰit séh₁yōmes? h₁íd séh₁yōmes h₁yód h₂wérseti. kʷóm h₁íd kh₂éydōmes? h₁íd sh₁séni kh₂éydōmes. nu dwóh₁ ugʷsénh₁e yugdʰí.
examples.en: Father, tell me, when shall we sow the barley? We will sow it when it rains. When shall we cut it? We will cut it at harvest time. Now yoke the two oxen!

examples.pie: bʰh₂dʰí moy kʷíd h₂usési dʰédʰeh₁si? h₂usési bʰéwdʰoh₂. h₂ówins h₂éǵrom déwkmi. kʷóm-kʷe bʰéwdʰesi? h₁yód sóh₂wl̥ léwkt bʰéwdʰoh₂. príHe Héh₂m̥ni sési.
examples.en: Speak to me: what do you do at dawn? At dawn I am awake. I lead the sheep to the pasture. And when are you awake? When the sun has become bright, I am awake. You sleep in the daylight, friend!
